_note: REVISION E of the asset registry (operator order t448u, 2026-10-26), PROPOSED, not adopted. Revision D (deployment/assetRegistry.revD.json, SHA-256 d8bb58d80d593f4e0e967ee82c239327055adb07cef8809fe48f7b95372903d4) with its Base subset extended to every technically compatible Base token of deployment/baseRegistryRecommendation_2026-10-26.csv. Rows of other environments are history, carried over unchanged, and are not registered by the Base-only ceremony. Built by scripts/buildRevisionE.cjs.

rules.membership: Every Section A and Section B Base token that is technically compatible: on-chain checks at one Base block (code, decimals() at most 65, balanceOf) and a local fork lock-and-release simulation of the real BaseCommitmentVaultLock bytecode. A token whose simulation could not be funded is kept as compatible_static_only. A token that failed the simulation is listed under notTechnicallyCompatible. TigerOG is kept by founder override. No liquidity, volume, market-cap or freshness threshold (t448u).
rules.classes: Row 454 USDC is S1, native ETH row 2 is S2, every other row is S3, including USDT row 1086 and every Section B stablecoin and wrapped token. No name-based multiplier (t448u).
rules.pricing: Unchanged scheduled pricing rules: CoinGecko by the row's pricingIdentifier, then DexScreener by the row's own Base contract (TigerOG may use a pool on any chain for its exact contract). Prices are posted as USD per whole token with 30 decimals (VF-ORC-016). A row with no usable price is pending, never excluded.
exclusions: TEL (old contract) 0x09bE1692ca16e06f536F0038fF11D1dA8524aDB1: superseded by the upgraded TEL contract (t430u item 3)
BAR: explicit exclusion (t447u, kept by t448u)
ACM: explicit exclusion (t447u, kept by t448u)
ASR: explicit exclusion (t447u, kept by t448u)
XCN: explicit exclusion (t447u, kept by t448u)
